# rocket

> Release engineering you can put in CI: an agent-native, self-improving deploy and CI/CD employee that gets code to production, proves it got there, and keeps rollback possible.

rocket is a senior release engineer as a tool. Coding agents call it through a CLI, an MCP server and skills; a person can watch it through a local cockpit. Its prime directive: a green check binds to a commit, an artifact and a config, so verify all three. Verify, don't trust the checkmark.

Default lane map: Vercel for web frontends, Fly or Railway for long-running backends and workers, Cloudflare for the edge, agent sandboxes and durable workflows, E2B for ephemeral agent compute, and GitHub Actions as the CI engine that binds them. The default `rocket wire` path is Vercel plus GitHub Actions; the other lanes are wired on demand.

Run it from GitHub with no clone: `npx -y -p github:naman10parikh/rocket rocket --help` for the CLI and `npx -y -p github:naman10parikh/rocket rocket-mcp` for the MCP server (stdio). Paths below are relative to the repository root.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): what rocket does, how to invoke every CLI and MCP tool, the boundary and the NOT-list.
- [CLAUDE.md](./CLAUDE.md): the Claude Code operating doc for this repository (the prime directive, the three house laws, the commit convention); it imports AGENTS.md.
- [README.md](./README.md): what it is, the quick start, and how to install it in any coding agent.

## Identity

- [identity/SOUL.md](./identity/SOUL.md): who rocket is (launch-director voice, gauge-driven, paranoid about green): identity, personality, boundaries.
- [identity/BRAND.md](./identity/BRAND.md): the name (rocket, the thing that ships: ignition, ascent, and an abort beats a bad orbit), the tagline and design tokens.
- [.well-known/agent.json](./.well-known/agent.json): the A2A agent card (name, description, endpoint, the 7 capabilities).

## The three house laws (from brain/OPINIONS.md)

1. Deploy strategy: blue-green by default; canary only when telemetry exists (you can define "healthy" before the rollout). For AI agents the canary metric is the eval score.
2. Eval-gated CI: block on regression, not an absolute floor. The dual threshold is an absolute floor plus a Welch's t delta against a rolling 7-day baseline. The gate is the evolving golden dataset; no self-grading.
3. Vercel: one push at a time, through Git integration only, with "Require Verified Commits" off. No rapid successive pushes, no deploy-hook workflows, no manual `vercel --prod` unless Git integration is confirmed broken. rocket's PreToolUse hook enforces this.

## CLI (`rocket`; `--json` on every read path; exit 0 when clean, non-zero on a finding, a NO-GO or a refusal)

- [wire](./tools/rocket/src/commands/wire.ts): `rocket wire --target <repo> [--lane vercel] [--strategy bluegreen|canary] [--dry-run]` is the acceptance test: an actionlint-clean workflow and Vercel deploy config, ready for you to commit. The Fly, Cloudflare and Railway lanes are planned.
- [audit](./tools/rocket/src/commands/audit.ts): `rocket audit <workflows dir or repo>` sweeps the attack classes with actionlint and zizmor and gives P0 and P1 findings with SHA-pin fixes.
- [verify](./tools/rocket/src/commands/verify.ts): `rocket verify --target <repo|url> [--sha <expected>]` checks both axes (the deployed SHA equals HEAD, and a behaviour smoke test passes) and answers GO or NO-GO.
- [rollback](./tools/rocket/src/commands/rollback.ts): `rocket rollback --target <repo> [--to <deployment|image>]` runs the rollback hierarchy fastest first (flag, alias repoint, image pin, git revert).
- [eval-gate](./tools/rocket/src/commands/eval-gate.ts): `rocket eval-gate --baseline <ref> [--floor <n>] [--seed-baseline]` gates on regression against a rolling baseline plus an absolute floor.
- [migrate-plan](./tools/rocket/src/commands/migrate-plan.ts): `rocket migrate-plan --diff <schema-diff>` writes the expand-contract three-phase plan and refuses a destructive change coupled with dependent code. Plan only; acorn owns the schema.
- [preview](./tools/rocket/src/commands/preview.ts): `rocket preview reap --repo <repo> [--older-than <d>]` lists, then tears down, leaked preview environments.
- [doctor](./tools/rocket/src/commands/doctor.ts): `rocket doctor` checks the toolbelt (act, actionlint, zizmor, gh, secrets, a searchable brain, a green eval).

The web-touching path (`verify` against a live preview URL) uses `bb`/Stagehand or `playwright-cli` through Bash; the Playwright MCP is banned.

## MCP server (`rocket-mcp`, 7 tools, stdio)

- [tools/rocket/src/mcp-server.ts](./tools/rocket/src/mcp-server.ts): the server. Tools: `rocket_wire`, `rocket_audit`, `rocket_verify`, `rocket_rollback`, `rocket_eval_gate`, `rocket_migrate_plan`, `rocket_preview_reap`, each a thin wrapper over the same core the CLI calls. Long-running calls (`verify`, `eval_gate`) carry the MCP Tasks seam. Hosted OAuth over Streamable HTTP is deferred.
- [.mcp.json](./.mcp.json): the config any MCP client can copy; it starts the server from GitHub. The development config is `.mcp.dev.json`.

## Skills (each encodes a specific rocket stance)

- [deploy-verify](./skills/deploy-verify/SKILL.md): the both-axes check (SHA compare plus behaviour smoke); the anti-checkmark reflex.
- [workflow-audit](./skills/workflow-audit/SKILL.md): mutable tags, transitive actions, pwn requests and cache poisoning, with actionlint and zizmor; pin and audit and minimise.
- [rollback-runbook](./skills/rollback-runbook/SKILL.md): a flag flip beats a redeploy; the "we got popped" runbook (revoke, purge the cache, SHA-pin, rotate).
- [migration-safety](./skills/migration-safety/SKILL.md): expand-contract; a destructive change ships as a separate deploy 24 to 72 hours after stable.
- [eval-gate-design](./skills/eval-gate-design/SKILL.md): block on regression, not a floor; the gate is the dataset; two gates; no self-grading.

## Sub-agents (`.claude/agents/`, flat)

- [pipeline-auditor](./.claude/agents/pipeline-auditor.md): the workflow attack-class sweep (mutable tag, pwn request, cache poisoning, OIDC misconfiguration).
- [deploy-verifier](./.claude/agents/deploy-verifier.md): the both-axes deploy check, answering GO or NO-GO.

## The brain (what rocket knows)

- [brain/MOC - rocket.md](./brain/MOC%20-%20rocket.md): the hub for the brain.
- [brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md](./brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md): the map of mastery by job to be done.
- [brain/OPINIONS.md](./brain/OPINIONS.md): the taste layer and the three house laws (OP-4 to OP-21).
- [brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md](./brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md): version-specific gotchas with detection and fix (P0 to P34).
- [brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md](./brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md): 15 real incidents that are the golden eval tasks (G1 to G15).
- [brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md](./brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md): canonical tools, defaults and alternatives, agent access, required secrets.
- [brain/GAPS-AND-DISPUTES.md](./brain/GAPS-AND-DISPUTES.md): where sources disagree, and what rocket settles by experiment.
- Query it: `bash scripts/memory-search.sh "<query>"` (BM25 over `brain/`).

## The boundary (release engineering only)

- Product features, UI and business logic go to pixel (frontend), turbo (backend) and pebble (mobile).
- Secrets at rest and a secrets manager go to hush; rocket consumes secrets (OIDC, `gh secret set`) but does not own rotation.
- Product-side error, crash and uptime monitoring go to canary; rocket gates on eval scores and deploy liveness.
- The database schema goes to acorn; rocket plans the migration ordering (expand-contract).
- Auth and payments go to badge and penny; rocket wires their deploys. The earning loop goes to helios.

## Install surfaces and self-improvement

- [.claude-plugin/plugin.json](./.claude-plugin/plugin.json): the Claude Code plugin (skills, sub-agents, hooks, MCP server); install with `/plugin marketplace add naman10parikh/rocket`.
- [.claude-plugin/marketplace.json](./.claude-plugin/marketplace.json): the one-plugin marketplace.
- [hooks/hooks.json](./hooks/hooks.json): the plugin's two hooks (the house-law guard on Bash, and the session-start house laws).
- [gemini-extension.json](./gemini-extension.json): the Gemini CLI extension.
- [workflows/rsi.workflow.js](./workflows/rsi.workflow.js): the deterministic, tokenless nightly loop; it writes a proposal to `proposals/` and never commits.
- [dsip.json](./dsip.json): the self-improvement contract (eval-gated, no self-grading, git snapback).
- [eval/run.mjs](./eval/run.mjs): the golden-task pyramid.
- The CLI is built to spec but npm publishing is parked; install it from GitHub as above.
